data_classification: confidential; may contain user-supplied sensitive data
scope: CEO and Chief of Staff text conversation records only

controls.caller_identity: exact protected Google issuer and subject binding
controls.live_storage: SQLite held in process memory; only an authenticated encrypted snapshot may be persisted
controls.live_encryption: AES-256-GCM with a unique random nonce per snapshot
controls.key_source: owner-only protected file; master key is not stored in the database or logs
controls.key_separation: independent HMAC-derived live-store and deletion-ledger encryption keys
controls.deletion_behavior: Immediately remove the caller-owned live conversation and retain an encrypted owner-bound deletion marker for restore suppression.
controls.backup_format: single AES-256-GCM authenticated envelope with a separately derived backup key and authenticated creation time
controls.restore_behavior: Replay protected deletion markers and retention before restored records may be served.
controls.restore_activation: quarantine output only; live replacement requires a separate reviewed operator action

remaining_activation_gates: Approve encryption-key owner, recovery custodian, and rotation policy
Verify owner isolation, idempotency, retention, deletion, encrypted backup expiry, and quarantined restore
Approve and deploy a dedicated persistent volume and backup location
Verify the exact production image, route, rollback, and unchanged existing workloads
Complete a controlled CEO persistence and reconnect check
